description.value: A Walmart Supercenter located in Dawson Creek, BC — the southern terminus of the Alaska Highway and a major resupply hub for long-distance cyclists heading north. As a full-format Supercenter, it carries a broad grocery selection alongside general merchandise. For touring cyclists tackling the Alaska Highway corridor, this is one of the last large-format stores before entering more remote stretches of northern BC.
